---
title: "Sync Totals"
description: "Overall sync metrics across all tribunals and dates."
output: /data/totals.json
format: object
---

Totais agregados: quantas entries temos, quantas no IA, quantas pendentes,
absent, unknown, e percentual de cobertura geral.

```{sql}
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') AS uploaded,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE djen_status = 'available' AND ia_status != 'uploaded') AS pending,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE djen_status = 'absent') AS absent,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE djen_status = '' AND ia_status != 'uploaded') AS unknown,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') / COUNT(*), 1) AS coverage_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tribunal) AS tribunals_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tribunal) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') AS tribunals_with_data
FROM manifest;
```
